truthPolicy.hosted: Use only the pre-reviewed fixture. Hosted makes no model request and sends no recipe data.
truthPolicy.local: Use a real local recording with explicit consent and visible gpt-5.6-terra metadata; never substitute fixture footage.

shots.screen: Open on the DinnerSync wordmark, then reveal three recipe cards beside one crowded kitchen timeline.
shots.action: Animate the three recipes converging on a single serve marker.
shots.narration: Cooking three dishes is not three timers. One oven, two burners, shared hands, and a fixed dinner time create a dependency problem that ordinary recipe apps ignore.
captions: Three recipes. One kitchen. One finish line.

shots.screen: Show the Hosted Demo mode card and its privacy copy before touching the sample button.
shots.action: Hold long enough for the Hosted privacy boundary to be readable.
shots.narration: First, the public Hosted Demo loads a pre-reviewed fixture in the browser. It makes zero model requests and sends no recipe data.
captions: Hosted Demo · pre-reviewed fixture · 0 model requests

shots.screen: Click Try the 650 kcal demo and follow the real transition directly into the pre-reviewed Review screen.
shots.action: Hold on the built-in reviewed fixture notice and the three-recipe decision ledger; do not imply that Setup remains visible after the click.
shots.narration: One click opens a pre-reviewed chicken, rice, and vegetable dinner for four, targeting 7 PM and an estimated 650 kilocalories per person.

shots.screen: Cut to a real localhost session, select Local AI, and show the OpenAI data notice and unchecked consent control.
shots.action: Paste the prepared recipe text, then click the consent checkbox on camera before submitting.
shots.narration: Now the real Local AI path. I paste recipe text, select Local AI, and consent before anything is sent to OpenAI.

shots.screen: Keep the real Local AI result visible with the exact gpt-5.6-terra model badge and schema and evidence validation indicators.
shots.action: Trim waiting time only; never replace this segment with Hosted fixture footage.
shots.narration: This is genuine Local AI, not fixture footage. Logged-in Codex runs gpt-5.6-terra, returns typed candidates, and the app validates schema and source evidence.
captions: Real Local AI · gpt-5.6-terra · schema + evidence validated

shots.screen: Return to the repeatable Hosted path and scroll through servings, ingredients, food states, steps, temperatures, and evidence excerpts.
shots.action: Pause on one source-evidence highlight and the completed decision ledger. The Hosted fixture is already reviewed; do not stage confirmation clicks.
shots.narration: The Hosted fixture is pre-reviewed, so judges can inspect ingredients, steps, temperatures, nutrition matches, and source evidence without staged confirmations. Local AI stays locked until human approval.
captions: Hosted fixture · pre-reviewed decisions · evidence visible

shots.screen: Show the traceable nutrition matches, catalog source, meal total, and per-person estimate.
shots.action: Pause on the estimate and safety copy without presenting it as a health guarantee.
shots.narration: Nutrition is separate deterministic math over traceable catalog records. DinnerSync shows each match and the estimated kcal per person; it is not medical advice.
captions: Estimated kcal · traceable catalog · not medical advice

shots.screen: Click Build the service timeline and pan across the dish tracks, shared-resource labels, dependencies, and serve marker.
shots.action: Use cursor callouts to connect overlapping work to oven, burner, and hands constraints.
shots.narration: After review, the scheduler builds one resource-feasible timeline. These tracks expose dependencies and conflicts across oven, burners, and hands, while the common serve marker keeps all three dishes inside the five-minute window.

shots.screen: Click Start cooking and show the live task cards with their Start, Complete, and Delay controls.
shots.action: Point to the replay status text that says normal dispatcher semantics are retained.
shots.narration: I start cooking from the validated plan. Every Start, Complete, and Delay is an explicit event against the same session state.
captions: One event dispatcher for live and replay

shots.screen: Click 60× replay and keep the advancing clock, active task, and event status visible together.
shots.action: Speed-ramp only the screen capture; do not reorder or synthesize events in the edit.
shots.narration: For a short judging demo, 60-times playback compresses waiting only. It does not change task order or invent outcomes; replay uses that same normal event dispatcher.
captions: 60× playback · speed changes, logic does not

shots.screen: Keep the chicken roast visible as the +8 minute event lands, then show pending task times and the serve forecast move.
shots.action: Freeze-frame the delay record and the replanned 7:08 PM finish marker for one beat.
shots.narration: During the chicken roast, the scenario records a real plus-eight-minute Delay event. DinnerSync replans only work that has not started, preserves completed facts, and moves the feasible finish to 7:08.

shots.screen: Land on Summary with planned and actual completion, run record, nutrition totals, and the next-service note visible.
shots.action: Highlight 7:00 PM, 7:08 PM, 8 min late, one recorded delay, and the critical-path note in sequence.
shots.narration: Summary compares the 7:00 planned finish with the recorded 7:08 completion, one delay, eight delay minutes, and the actual replan passes. Its next-service note comes only from critical-path evidence.
captions: Planned 7:00 PM · actual 7:08 PM · 8 min late

shots.screen: Show a two-column architecture card labeled AI candidate extraction and Deterministic application core.
shots.action: Reveal the Codex boundary first, then the validation, nutrition, scheduler, session, persistence, and Summary modules.
shots.narration: GPT-5.6 structures candidates. Deterministic TypeScript owns review, nutrition, scheduling, replay, replanning, and Summary.
captions: AI: candidate extraction · Code: validation, math, schedule, state

shots.screen: End on the product mark with three concise boundary cards for Hosted, Local AI, and human decisions.
shots.action: Hold the final frame for one second with the project name and Apps for Your Life track.
shots.narration: Hosted has no Local AI route. Local use requires loopback, consent, validation, and human judgment for allergens and food safety.
captions: No hosted model route · local consent · validated boundaries
